origin.origins.arachnid.description: Their climbing abilities and web mastery make the Arachnid perfect hunters. They prefer meat but can eat anything.
origin.origins.avian.description: Graceful sky-dwellers who thrive at high altitudes. They gain speed and agility the higher they go, and prefer plant-based foods.
origin.origins.blazeborn.description: Late descendants of the Blaze, naturally immune to fire and lava. Water dampens their inner flame, slowing them down.
origin.origins.enderian.description: Born as children of the Ender Dragon, Enderians can teleport and gain a damage surge after shifting. Water saps their strength.
origin.origins.merling.description: Natural inhabitants of the ocean who thrive underwater. They can survive on land but grow sluggish if they stay dry too long.
origin.origins.phantom.description: Half-human, half-phantom beings who can phase through blocks. Their spectral form grants only half health, and sunlight weakens them.
origin.origins.shulk.description: Related to Shulkers, their shell-like skin provides natural armor and protects equipment from death penalties. Their armored bodies mine faster but need more fuel.
power.origins.carnivore.name: Meat Preference
power.origins.carnivore.description: Non-meat foods provide 50% less nourishment. Your spider metabolism prefers protein.
power.origins.vegetarian.name: Plant Preference
power.origins.vegetarian.description: Meat provides 50% less nourishment. Your avian digestion favors plants and grains.
power.origins.fresh_air.name: Sky Affinity
power.origins.fresh_air.description: You gain speed and agility at high altitudes. Above Y=80: Speed I + Jump Boost I. Above Y=150: enhanced further with Slow Falling.
power.origins.burn_in_daylight.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
power.origins.burn_in_daylight.descripti: Direct sunlight causes Weakness and Slowness. Wear a helmet or stay in shade to avoid the effects.
power.origins.hunger_over_time.name: Restless Hunger
power.origins.hunger_over_time.descripti: Your spectral nature burns energy 25% faster than normal.
power.origins.more_exhaustion.name: Heavy Metabolism
power.origins.more_exhaustion.descriptio: Your armored body requires 25% more fuel than others.
power.origins.water_vulnerability.name: Water Discomfort
power.origins.water_vulnerability.descri: Contact with water slows you and saps your strength.
power.origins.water_breathing.name: Amphibious
power.origins.water_breathing.descriptio: You breathe underwater naturally. On land, you gradually grow sluggish if you stay dry for more than 5 minutes.
power.origins.damage_from_snowballs.name: Cold Sensitive
power.origins.damage_from_snowballs.desc: Your fiery nature makes cold uncomfortable.
power.origins.nether_spawn.name: Nether Affinity
power.origins.nether_spawn.description: You deal 10% more damage and take 10% less damage in the Nether. After your first Nether visit, this doubles and applies everywhere.
power.origins.shulker_inventory.name: Hardened Shell
power.origins.shulker_inventory.descript: Your shell-like skin protects your equipment. Durability loss on death is reduced.
power.origins.strong_arms.name: Strong Arms
power.origins.strong_arms.description: Your powerful arms mine blocks 20% faster.
power.origins.strong_arms_break_speed.de: Your strong arms let you mine 20% faster.
origin.origins.feline.description: With their cat-like appearance, Felines are agile and silent. Their dexterity lets them always land safely, but their light frames mean 20% less health.
power.origins.nine_lives.name: Nine Lives
power.origins.nine_lives.description: Your feline agility comes at a cost: 20% less maximum health.
power.origins.throw_ender_pearl.name: Ender Shift
power.origins.throw_ender_pearl.descript: Teleport forward on a 60-second cooldown, or throw an ender pearl. After teleporting, deal 15% more damage for 10 seconds.
power.origins.fragile.name: Spectral Form
power.origins.fragile.description: Your half-phantom nature leaves you with only half the health of a normal being.
origin.origins.human.name: Mundane
origin.origins.human.description: An ordinary being with no special powers or weaknesses. The balanced choice for those who prefer to let their Race and Class define them.
